description: W3 (bean qou-bbsy, re-scoped after the channel audit): certifies that the GGM Stokes matrix of 4_1 satisfies S12 + S21 = 3*S11 exactly as an integer q-series identity (and det = 1), so the T4/T5 A_omega = 3 is a STRUCTURE CONSTANT — exact, q-independent, not an entry value that deforms at the substrate. Separates the three readings that coincide at q->0 (raw entry 1.5852, value-ratio 3.7067, symmetry constant 3) and records that the theta-reality bound A >= 2.054 excludes the raw entry. The original bean asked for a self-consistent theta fixed point using the winding A_eff; that was re-scoped because A_eff is sigma1sigma1 while A_omega is sigma1sigma2 — running it as specified would have hard-wired the cross-channel error. Identification is a reading selection, not a derivation of 3. Nothing wired.

data.verdict: A_ω = 3 IS AN EXACT STRUCTURE CONSTANT, q-INDEPENDENT. The certified Stokes matrix satisfies S⁺₁₂ + S⁺₂₁ = 3·S⁺₁₁ exactly, coefficient-by-coefficient through q^400 (and det S⁺ = 1). So the integer 3 is the coefficient of an identity holding at every order — not the value of an entry, and nothing about it deforms at the substrate. Of the three readings that coincide at q→0, the raw entry (1.5852) is EXCLUDED by the ϑ-reality bound A ≥ 2.054 (ThetaRealityBound), the value-ratio (3.7067) is q-dependent, and the symmetry constant is exactly 3 at all q. The corpus T4/T5 value is therefore VINDICATED, and 'does A_ω deform at the substrate?' was ill-posed. Scope-(a): the identities are exact and certified; the IDENTIFICATION of A_ω with the symmetry constant is a reading selection (reality exclusion + q-independence), NOT a derivation of 3 from the categorical drivers — that stays open. Nothing wired.
